correctness.rationale: Independent centered Gaussian normalization gives conditional sign correlation rho_m(d,s)=C(d,d-s)^-1 sum_j (-1)^j C(m,j)C(d-m,d-s-j). The normalized monomials x_S are orthonormal on S^(d-1); off-diagonal restriction entries are w(2/pi)^(k-r)rho_(2(k-r)), where r=|S∩T|, w=2^-d C(d,s). Binomial inversion expands this matrix in W_l W_l^T inclusion products, whose classical Johnson eigenvalues on V_i are C(k-i,l-i)C(d-l-i,k-l), multiplicities C(d,i)-C(d,i-1). The proof accounts for every C(d,k) dimension and gives a strict 0<lambda<1 because nonzero homogeneous polynomials cannot vanish on open subsets of region/complement. rho2=(t²-d)/(d(d-1)) with t=2s-d gives k1 isotropy iff t²=d. For k2, rho4|_(t²=d)=-2/((d-2)(d-3)) excludes isotropy, and Kneser pair-disjoint adjacency gives the displayed three levels. Independent full-matrix eigenvalue comparisons over d4..9 supported these exact identities. This proof does NOT claim all pure harmonics, only the squarefree subspace.
